headline: Crusoe sells unfinished Wyoming data center to Google
script: Crusoe has sold an unfinished data center project in Wyoming to Google. Google had tried and failed to become a customer of that project. Google is now taking over the development itself. Reports say Google had raised concerns about the cost and the construction timeline under Crusoe. Crusoe first announced the project last year with Tallgrass, a Blackstone-backed infrastructure company. They planned to scale it to ten gigawatts of power capacity. Google did not say how much it paid Crusoe for the unfinished project. But Google plans to invest seventeen billion dollars to develop the data center campus. The deal shows how hard it is for independent developers to deliver huge projects on time and within budget. Securing equipment and power is a challenge, and local opposition can make development even harder. Google has not walked away from Crusoe entirely. Crusoe is building another data center for Google near Amarillo, Texas. Crusoe also raised three point nine billion dollars in September, despite the Wyoming setback.

sentences.zh: 谷歌此前曾试图成为该项目的客户，但没有成功。

sentences.text: Google is now taking over the development itself.
sentences.zh: 如今谷歌正亲自接手这一开发项目。

sentences.text: Reports say Google had raised concerns about the cost and the construction timeline under Crusoe.
sentences.zh: 据报道，谷歌曾对Crusoe管理下的成本和建设进度表示担忧。

sentences.text: They planned to scale it to ten gigawatts of power capacity.
sentences.zh: 双方计划最终将该项目扩展至十吉瓦的电力容量。

sentences.zh: 谷歌没有透露它为这个未完工项目向Crusoe支付了多少钱。

sentences.text: The deal shows how hard it is for independent developers to deliver huge projects on time and within budget.
sentences.zh: 这笔交易表明，独立开发商要按时、按预算交付大型项目有多么困难。

sentences.text: Securing equipment and power is a challenge, and local opposition can make development even harder.
sentences.zh: 获取设备和电力本身就是挑战，当地社区的反对还可能让开发更加困难。

terms.note: 集中放置大量服务器、用于存储和计算数据的建筑设施。
功率单位，一吉瓦等于十亿瓦，这里指数据中心可用的电力容量。
指支撑大型项目运转的电力、网络、建筑等基础条件。
这里指由多栋建筑组成的数据中心集中区域。
指项目推进中遇到的阻碍或失利。

grammar.point: 过去完成时 had tried and failed
grammar.note: 表示在谷歌接手之前就已发生的尝试，中文常只说“曾试图”而漏掉 had。

grammar.point: 形式主语 how hard it is for... to...
grammar.note: it 是形式主语，真正的主语是 to deliver 不定式；中文习惯直接说“做某事很难”，容易漏掉 it。
despite 后直接接名词，不能接句子；中文说“尽管……”，容易误加 that 或改成 although。

questions.q: What did Crusoe do with the Wyoming project?
options: It sold the unfinished project to Google.
It finished the project and leased it to Google.
questions.explain: 答案在第一句，Crusoe 把未完工的怀俄明项目卖给了谷歌。

questions.q: How much does Google plan to invest in the data center campus?
questions.explain: 答案在第八句，谷歌计划投资一百七十亿美元开发该园区。
